items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Hammer Barrett. Now this guy on this side is going to look like Joe Watson to me... Because he played with Ridgely in a while. No, I didn't know that. I forgot that.

ctx.x: Robert Hall. Robert Hall, yeah. Hammer Barrett. Now this guy on this side is going to look like Joe Watson to me. Might be. Because he played with Ridgely in a while. No, I didn't know that. I forgot that. Yeah, he played with Ridgely a while on the parallel. Which one? Alto or the? Alto. Yeah, the alto. Yeah, he played with Ridgely. That looked like Joe to me. It might not be. They don't say on that. It says Durban. Often do it. . . . .
This is Real Three, Alfred Williams.
